text:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy: release/2026.03.21 -> prod. Change window 21:00-22:00 UTC. Preflight snapshot of SLOs created: https://grafana.company/s/dash/rls-slo-snapshot-1902123456 :robot_face:
ashley: copying the snapshot link to the #deploy-runbook, i'll watch p95/p99 for inference-api and embed-service.
sam: seeing a small p95 blip on embed-service at 21:03 in the canary (50%) — +120ms over baseline. not sure if it's noise or KV-cache warming. :thinking_face:
kai: sharing quick query for traces and quantiles:
```
sum by (route) (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[1m])))
```
use last 5m window.
maria: checking autoscale and GPUs, metrics look stable, CPU on proxy jumped though. Could be a routing surge to v2 weights.
sam: logs from canary pod: `WARN kv_cache: miss 0.82, filling async` and a couple of 502s from upstream embedger at 21:03:12.
ashley: canary flagged, holding further traffic shift. tagging oncall: @maria can you pause rollout?
maria: paused rollout via deploy UI at 21:04:08. :white_check_mark: will dig in.
kai: suggestion: pin canary to model:v2026-03-15-quant to see if quantization changes caused it. we can route 100% of canary buckets to the pinned variant for comparison.
sam: quick A/B request: continue canary variant A (current) vs B (pinned) at 10/10 split for 5m. I'm running the route rule now.
maria: watch alerts: SLO p95 > 200ms for 3m triggers page. currently at 210ms for embed-service on canary group.
ashley: ops-note: enable extra logs for kv_cache and proxy for the canary group (sample 30%).
sam: after switching pinned variant, p95 went down to baseline within 90s. embed-service error rate also dropped from 0.9% -> 0.12%.
maria: looks like quant changes introduced a regression. proposing rollback of model variant in canary and abort further rollout. Opinions?
kai: +1 rollback canary, open a regression issue and block auto-rollout. Also suggests we add this prompt/trace to the quality monitor.
ashley: rolling back canary to model:v2026-03-15-quant now. documented in release notes: "rollback: canary model variant due to p95 spike on embed-service; pinned to v2026-03-15-quant until patch".
maria: rollback completed at 21:07:30. Deploy paused and flagged for post-deploy analysis. :warning:
sam: re-ran the SLO snapshot at 21:09:40: https://grafana.company/s/dash/rls-slo-snapshot-1902123580 — p95 back to baseline.
kai: I'll file an immediate regression ticket with traces + failing prompts + reproducer. assign to eng-ml and eng-runtime.
ashley: thanks all. action items: 1) eng-ml to investigate quant changes (ticket #INC-2026) 2) add canary A/B guard in deployer to require 10m stability before moving 100% 3) postmortem if we see recurrence.
maria: adding post-deploy note to the incident channel and scheduling 30min sync tomorrow. :calendar:
deploy-bot: Deploy paused by @maria. Status: canary rolled back, snapshot stored (1902123456 -> 1902123580).
